titre: Contrats à terme échangés dans le monde
sous_titre: Mds de contrats par mois, janvier à juin 2026

series.nom: Contrats à terme échangés dans le monde

Janvier 2026.texte: Global trading of futures reached 2.95 billion contracts in January, up 33.3% from the same month last year.

Février 2026.texte: Global trading of futures reached 2.64 billion contracts in February, up 14.7% from the same month last year.

Mars 2026.texte: Global trading of futures reached 4.16 billion contracts in March, up 57.9% from the same month last year.

Avril 2026.texte: Global trading of futures reached 3.02 billion contracts in April, up 7.1% from the same month last year.

Mai 2026.texte: Global trading of futures reached 2.98 billion contracts in May, up 25.6% from the same month last year.

Juin 2026.texte: Global trading of futures reached 3.38 billion contracts in June, up 38.9% from the same month last year.
